workspace.work_cell: 8*hex_shape_arg_nlev*hex_shape_arg_nedges + 4*hex_shape_arg_nlev*hex_shape_arg_ncells float64 elements; eight edge contribution planes and four cell accumulation planes

alias: Primal fields follow the captured forward aliases. Incoming output-seed buffers are writable and disjoint from all outgoing input-cotangent buffers, other fields, workspace and failure buffers; the entry clears exactly the forward-overwritten indices after consuming their seeds.
helper: hex-ad/cuda/acoustic/acoustic_mpas_fp32.cuh is the exact pinned CUDA_FTZ_HELPERS source

polynomial_cases.reason: each output is dts times tend_ru; this degree applies only to this fixed schedule arm

cotangent_reduction: Repeated reads and shared inputs accumulate in fixed order in float64; each float32 cotangent is rounded once on its final write (COMMON-AD section 40). Output seeds are separate writable buffers; the reverse consumes each overwritten slot and leaves untouched seed slots unchanged.

capture_scalar_names.note: The archived own-capture source uses these formal names and specializes their values to captured constexpr dimensions. The derivative parameter names remain nlev, nedges and ncells; the launch ABI binds them in the same order.
